node.statement: The operator-space axioms in def-operator-space imply the simple-tensor identity ||T tensor z||_n=||T||*||z|| for T in M_n and z in calX: the rectangular matrix inequality gives the upper bound, while compression by unit vectors u,v chosen with |u^*Tv|=||T|| gives ||T||*||z||=||(u^* tensor 1)(T tensor z)(v tensor 1)||<=||T tensor z||. This applies uniformly at every n.
